key_findings.clean_levels_no_cross_edges: H0/V0 have 0 cross kNN edges between leaf a/b; the clean-V0 selectivity guard is vacuous on clean levels
key_findings.boundary_levels_collapse: H1 (9767 cross) + V1 (13027 cross): within c_mv == cross c_mv == 0.30 (margin 0.000) under BOTH winner_take_all and transmittance_k2
key_findings.c_vis_c_app_collapse: 62-74% of a/b gaussians visible in 0 views -> Jaccard c_vis and cosine c_app both 0.0 for within AND cross
key_findings.c_occ_saturation: c_occ ~1.0 because neither endpoint visible -> no occlusion separation to score
key_findings.transmittance_k2: raises coverage (0.264->0.363) but does NOT restore discriminability (margin still 0.000)

scientific_conclusion: View-synthesized visibility/appearance/occlusion cues from a static 3DGS splat cloud do not provide instance-discriminative connectivity for overlap resolution: the synthetic cameras re-project the same static geometry and introduce no new information about leaf identity. This confirms the plan's designed honest-FAIL: overlap failures are not remediable by local geometry estimation (Task 3 G4 FAIL) NOR by synthetic multi-view reasoning (Task 4 FAIL). The bottleneck is missing real multi-view instance evidence (captured images / 2D instance masks).
